## List Calendar Events

Lists calendar events matching optional date range, entity link, or organizer criteria.

**Endpoint**: `GET {{base_url}}/api/v1/calendar/events`  
**Tags**: `Company Calendar & Events, Company Calendar & Events`

### URL & Query Parameters

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `start_date` | `query` | `string` | No | Filter events ending on or after this timestamp |
| `end_date` | `query` | `string` | No | Filter events starting on or before this timestamp |
| `res_model` | `query` | `string` | No | Filter by attached record entity model |
| `res_id` | `query` | `string` | No | Filter by attached record entity ID |
| `organizer_id` | `query` | `string` | No | Filter by event organizer |
| `limit` | `query` | `integer` | No | - |

| Status Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `200` | Successful Response |
| `422` | Validation Error |

## Create Calendar Event

Creates a new calendar event, appointment, or recurring meeting with optional initial invitees.

**Endpoint**: `POST {{base_url}}/api/v1/calendar/events`  
**Tags**: `Company Calendar & Events, Company Calendar & Events`

### Request Body Fields (JSON Payload)

| Field | Type | Required | Allowed Values / Choices | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `title` | `string` | **Yes** | Any valid string | Event title or subject |
| `description` | `string` | No | Any valid string | Detailed agenda or notes |
| `start_time` | `string` | **Yes** | Any valid string | Event start timestamp (with timezone) |
| `end_time` | `string` | **Yes** | Any valid string | Event end timestamp (with timezone) |
| `is_all_day` | `boolean` | No | Any valid boolean | Whether event spans full day |
| `recurrence_rule` | `string` | No | Any valid string | RFC 5545 RRULE string (e.g. 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE;COUNT=10') |
| `res_model` | `string` | No | Any valid string | Linked entity model name (e.g. 'parties') |
| `res_id` | `string` | No | Any valid string | Linked entity record ID |
| `location` | `string` | No | Any valid string | Meeting location or URL |
| `status` | `string` | No | Any valid string | confirmed, tentative, cancelled |
| `color` | `string` | No | Any valid string | UI calendar display color |
| `custom_fields` | `object` | No | Any valid object | custom_fields attribute |
| `attendees` | `array` | No | Any valid array | Initial invitees |


### Expected HTTP Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `201` | Successful Response |
| `422` | Validation Error |
